review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact writable binding scope, task roles, verification dependency, readiness and evidence stages agree with the original PRD. The source places the shared parameter declaration and decode transform in core/api.ts; classic and mini consume that parameter type and forward arguments, while util and export modules support read-only compatibility inspection rather than mandatory edits. Existing encode logic confirms case normalization, first-entry selection and empty-first-entry fallback, consistent with AC-003. The supplied build configuration supports treating declarations as generated outputs, not separately maintained owners. Both regression paths are covered by the supplied test/typecheck configuration; compile-mode runtime testing is not being substituted for TypeScript checking. The designated implementer and verifier have active project-scoped trusted claims for the bounded scope, including data.change, and the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy mappings and Persona descriptions are not needed to establish eligibility. A distinct configured project reviewer supports the earlier independent-review prerequisite without requiring execution claims. No unresolved material DEC-001 is present in this bundle's supplied specification or decision inputs, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved material decision in a B variant would instead block at decisions, and a fixed hypothetical C input would not constitute a human Decision. Repository identity and base commit agree, and the Gold and preview release fingerprints match across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and policy. The provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Historical project reuse is consistent with preserving scoped attestations and retaining old-version operations, not evidence of candidate execution on this bundle. This approval relies solely on the supplied review data and Service-bound fingerprints; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or provide human attestation.
